test_cases.test_name: X-bar/R Chart Creation and Nelson Rules Application
test_cases.objective: To verify that the SPC dashboard can correctly create X-bar/R control charts from a CSV file and accurately apply the vendor's standard Nelson rules to identify out-of-control points.
prerequisites: SPC dashboard software is installed and accessible
Test CSV file with at least 100 rows of sample data (subgroups) is available
User account with 'Analyst' role permissions is created

test_steps.action: Log into the SPC dashboard using the 'Analyst' role credentials.
test_steps.expected_result: Login is successful and the main dashboard interface is displayed.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the main dashboard screen

test_steps.action: Navigate to the 'Create New Chart' function and select the option to create an X-bar/R chart.
test_steps.expected_result: The system displays a dialog to upload or select a data source.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the chart creation dialog

test_steps.action: Upload the prepared test CSV file using the standard file browser.
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully loads the file and displays a preview of the data columns.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the data preview screen
Time taken to load the file

test_steps.action: Map the appropriate columns from the CSV to the X-bar and R chart data fields (e.g., subgroup identifier, measurement values).
test_steps.expected_result: The system accepts the column mappings and enables the 'Generate Chart' button.
data_to_capture: Screenshot showing the completed column mapping

test_steps.action: Enable the 'Apply Nelson Rules' option in the chart configuration and generate the chart.
test_steps.expected_result: The system renders the X-bar and R charts, with points violating Nelson rules clearly highlighted or annotated.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the final rendered charts
Time taken to render the charts after generation

acceptance_criteria: X-bar and R charts are generated and displayed correctly from the CSV data.
The system correctly identifies and highlights data points that violate the vendor's standard Nelson rules.
The chart rendering time is less than 2 seconds after generation.
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 211.68 requires automated equipment to reliably perform intended functions.
General GAMP principles for verification of standard software functionality.
data_integrity_requirements: The original data from the CSV must be accurately represented in the chart without alteration.
The application of Nelson rules must be consistent and based solely on the input data.

test_cases.test_name: Data Export and Role-Based Access Control Verification
test_cases.objective: To confirm that the system enforces role-based view access for released datasets and allows standard export functions (PDF/CSV) only for authorized users.
prerequisites: SPC dashboard is installed and running
A control chart has been created and marked as 'Released'
Two user accounts are created: one with 'Viewer' role and one with 'Guest' role
The 'Viewer' role has export permissions, the 'Guest' role does not

test_steps.action: Log into the SPC dashboard using the 'Viewer' role credentials.
test_steps.expected_result: Login is successful. The main dashboard shows only the modules and functions permitted for the 'Viewer' role.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the dashboard view for the 'Viewer' role

test_steps.action: Navigate to and open the pre-released control chart dataset.
test_steps.expected_result: The system allows access to view the chart. The data and chart are displayed in a read-only mode.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the chart view with read-only indicators visible

test_steps.action: Attempt to export the chart as a PDF using the vendor's standard export function.
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully generates and downloads a PDF file of the chart.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the export success message

test_steps.action: Log out of the application and then log in using the 'Guest' role credentials.
test_steps.expected_result: Login is successful. The interface shows a restricted set of options compared to the 'Viewer' role.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the dashboard view for the 'Guest' role

test_steps.action: Attempt to navigate to and view the same released control chart.
test_steps.expected_result: The system either prevents access to the chart or displays an 'Access Denied' message, enforcing read-only access control.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the access denied message or the restricted view

test_steps.action: From the 'Guest' account, attempt to find and use any export to PDF or CSV function on an accessible chart.
test_steps.expected_result: The export functions are either hidden, disabled, or return a permissions error when attempted.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the disabled export button or permissions error

acceptance_criteria: The system correctly restricts access to released datasets based on user roles.
Users with appropriate permissions (Viewer) can successfully export data to PDF.
Users without export permissions (Guest) are prevented from exporting data.
Released data is presented in a read-only format as required.
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11.10(d) requires limiting system access to authorized individuals.
URS-020-007 mandates read-only access for released datasets.
data_integrity_requirements: Exported PDF/CSV files must be an accurate representation of the data displayed on the screen.
Access controls must prevent unauthorized modification or export of released data.

test_cases.objective: Verify that the system can successfully schedule and send automated report emails using the vendor's built-in scheduler functionality.

Valid user account with scheduling permissions
Email server configured in system

Email recipient address configured

test_steps.action: Log into the system with a user account that has scheduling permissions
test_steps.expected_result: Successful login and access to scheduling features

test_steps.action: Navigate to the report scheduling section and configure a new scheduled report
test_steps.expected_result: Scheduling interface loads successfully with all configuration options available

test_steps.action: Configure a test report with PDF export format, set immediate execution, and specify recipient email
test_steps.expected_result: Report configuration is accepted without errors

test_steps.action: Save and activate the scheduled report configuration
test_steps.expected_result: System confirms successful scheduling activation

test_steps.action: Verify email delivery to specified recipient within expected timeframe
test_steps.expected_result: Email with attached PDF report is received successfully

acceptance_criteria: Scheduled reports are generated and emailed successfully
PDF format is maintained in email attachments
Reports contain accurate data from the configured dataset
Scheduling occurs within expected timeframe

data_integrity_requirements: Scheduled reports must maintain data accuracy and completeness
Email distribution must be secure and reliable
urs_requirements: URS-020-006: The system shall support scheduled report emails using vendor scheduler
related_tests: OQ-002: Data Export and Role-Based Access Control Verification

test_cases.test_name: Large Dataset Performance and Chart Rendering Test
test_cases.objective: Verify system performance meets requirements when loading large datasets and rendering charts after filter changes.
prerequisites: System installed on supported hardware
Test dataset with 100k+ data points prepared
Performance monitoring tools available
Clean test environment without other processes running

test_steps.action: Prepare a CSV file containing exactly 100,000 data points for import
test_steps.expected_result: CSV file created with proper format and exact data point count

test_steps.action: Initiate data import process and start timer simultaneously
test_steps.expected_result: Import process begins immediately after initiation

test_steps.action: Monitor import progress and stop timer when complete confirmation appears
test_steps.expected_result: Data import completes successfully with all points loaded

test_steps.action: Apply a filter to the dataset and initiate chart rendering, starting timer
test_steps.expected_result: Filter is applied and chart rendering begins

test_steps.action: Stop timer when chart is fully rendered and interactive
test_steps.expected_result: Chart displays completely with all data points visible

test_steps.action: Repeat steps 4-5 with different filter combinations (3 iterations)
test_steps.expected_result: Consistent performance across multiple filter changes

acceptance_criteria: 100k data points load in less than 5 seconds
Charts render in less than 2 seconds after filter changes
No system crashes or performance degradation during testing
Consistent performance across multiple test iterations
regulatory_basis: FDA guidance on computerized systems performance
data_integrity_requirements: Large datasets must maintain accuracy during import and processing
Filtered views must accurately represent the underlying data
urs_requirements: URS-020-010: Load 100k data points in < 5 seconds on supported hardware
URS-020-011: Render charts in < 2 seconds after filter changes
related_tests: OQ-001: X-bar/R Chart Creation and Nelson Rules Application

test_cases.test_name: Read-Only Access and Configuration Record Retention
test_cases.objective: To verify that released datasets are read-only and chart configurations are retained as controlled records per regulatory requirements.
prerequisites: System with sample datasets
Released dataset marked as controlled
User with viewer permissions
Saved chart configurations

test_steps.action: Log in as a user with viewer permissions and attempt to access a released dataset
test_steps.expected_result: System allows access to the dataset but all editing functions are disabled

test_steps.action: Attempt to modify data points in the released dataset
test_steps.expected_result: System prevents any modifications and displays read-only warning message

test_steps.action: Save a chart configuration with specific parameters and mark as controlled
test_steps.expected_result: System saves the configuration and assigns controlled record status

test_steps.action: Log out and log back in, then attempt to retrieve the saved configuration
test_steps.expected_result: Configuration is retrievable with all parameters intact and unchanged

test_steps.action: Attempt to modify the controlled configuration record
test_steps.expected_result: System prevents modifications to controlled records or creates new version if supported

acceptance_criteria: Released datasets are completely read-only for all users
Chart configurations are retained without alteration
Controlled records cannot be modified without proper controls
System enforces access restrictions appropriately
data_integrity_requirements: Immutable controlled records
Prevention of unauthorized modifications
Accurate retention of configuration parameters
urs_requirements: URS-020-007: Read-only access for released datasets
URS-020-008: Retain chart configurations as controlled records
related_tests: OQ-002: Data Export and Role-Based Access Control Verification
OQ-006: Audit Trail and Configuration Change Tracking Verification

test_cases.test_name: Role-Based View Access and Read-Only Enforcement Test

prerequisites: System installed with AD integration configured
Multiple user accounts with different role assignments

test_steps.expected_result: Successful login with appropriate dashboard view based on role
